jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Field Systems (Salesforce)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Field Systems team, the group responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling the commercial go-to market tools including CRM, e-signature, opportunity management, sales engagement, marketing automation, and forecasting platforms. You will own the product roadmap and serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and an agile delivery team to ensure the right work gets prioritized, scoped, and shipped at the right time.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of enterprise systems, business strategy, and Scaled agile execution. You'll thrive here if you love translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, leveraging modern AI tools to work smarter and faster, and partnering closely with sales, marketing, finance, and customer success to drive measurable outcomes.

You will report to our Director, Field Systems. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.

You Will

Partner with the Director of Field Systems to define, maintain, and communicate a prioritized product roadmap aligned to company go-to-market objectives
Continuously assess the value, urgency, and feasibility of roadmap initiatives to ensure the team is always working on the highest-impact problems
Translate strategic priorities into quarterly PI (Program Increment) objectives within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
Engage directly with internal stakeholders including Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Technical Support to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and business goals
Define clear epics, features, and user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria.
Lead discovery activities including stakeholder interviews, process walkthroughs, and data analysis to inform solution design
Leverage AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to accelerate requirements documentation, synthesize stakeholder feedback, draft communications, and surface insights from data bringing a modern, AI-augmented approach to everyday PM work
Serve as the Product Owner for the agile team, owning and grooming the team backlog to ensure a healthy queue of well-refined work
Actively participate in SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Refinement, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospectives, and System Demos
Make real-time prioritization and trade-off decisions to keep the team moving and unblocked
Maintain transparent, proactive communication with stakeholders on roadmap status, delivery timelines, and change impacts
Build trust with business partners by consistently delivering on commitments and surfacing risks early
Collaborate with change management and enablement teams to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities
Define success metrics for features and initiatives; track outcomes post-deployment and use data to inform future prioritization
Drive retrospective insights from delivery into roadmap refinement and team process improvements

You Have

5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on go-to market tools and platform products in an enterprise environment
Demonstrated experience working within SAFe or agile framework, including PI Planning and cross-team coordination
Strong product sense with experience balancing user needs, business value, and technical feasibility
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present confidently to senior leaders and technical teams alike
Experience writing detailed epics and features, lean business cases, and user stories with strong assumptions and acceptance criteria
Comfort with data including the ability to query data, interpret metrics, and build business cases
Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification
Experience supporting sales operations, revenue operations, or marketing operations functions
Familiarity with CPQ, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud implementations
Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) applied to PM workflows such as documentation, research, or analysis.
SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification
Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Current US Perks & Benefits

Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$135,000 - $176,250 USD

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Outbound Product Manager - Service Collection
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About The Opportunity

Service Collection is building the next generation of enterprise service management: a governed, connected operating system that helps organisations transform how their people, technology, and services work together.

We are hiring a US-based Outbound Product Manager
to turn our High Touch go-to-market plays into a repeatable product and commercial advantage. This role will work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

The Primary Focus Will Be

Transformation & Compete: helping customers move from fragmented or incumbent platforms to a modern Service Collection operating model, with particular emphasis on competitive displacement and credible enterprise differentiation.
Enterprise Trust & Compliance: translating security, compliance, data governance, residency, reliability, and regulated-industry requirements into product strategy, roadmap influence, field readiness, and customer proof.

The OPM is not a quota-carrying seller, and this is not a conventional product marketing role. You will sit at the intersection of product strategy and the field as a mini GM: identifying patterns in enterprise opportunities, converting customer and competitive evidence into product action, shaping the narrative and proof points for strategic plays, and building the operating mechanisms that allow teams to execute consistently.

Responsibilities

What you will do
1. Own the operating system for the priority plays

Translate the Service Collection High Touch GTM play strategy into clear operating plans, priorities, milestones, dependencies, and decision forums.
Establish a trusted view of play health across pipeline signals, customer evidence, product readiness, competitive risk, trust and compliance gaps, and execution blockers.
Run a lightweight monthly operating rhythm with play owners and cross-functional partners; increase cadence only when execution requires it.
Define the few decisions that need executive attention, bring well-formed recommendations, and drive closure rather than creating more meetings.
Connect beachhead-play signals to the broader Transformation & Compete motion so that field evidence compounds across the portfolio.

2. Turn enterprise field signals into product strategy

Build a systematic feedback loop across strategic accounts, win/loss evidence, customer advisory conversations, sales engineering, support, and implementation teams.
Separate recurring market evidence from one-off requests and distinguish table stakes, differentiated capabilities, packaging gaps, delivery gaps, and enablement gaps.
Quantify the commercial and customer impact of the most important gaps where data is available; make uncertainty explicit where it is not.
Produce concise, executive-ready briefs that answer: what is changing, why it matters, how strong the evidence is, what we should do, and what decision is required.
Make sure customer and competitive claims are evidence-backed, current, and usable by Product, Sales, Marketing, and leadership.

3. Lead cross-functional execution without formal authority

Align senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, Legal, Security, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership around a small number of outcomes.
Create clarity when ownership is distributed or ambiguous; make handoffs explicit and surface risks early.
Facilitate difficult trade-offs across customer impact, strategic differentiation, revenue potential, delivery cost, trust risk, and operational complexity.
Use written decision records, clear action owners, and measurable follow-through to keep momentum across time zones.
Represent the play strategy in selected leadership, field, and customer forums with confidence and precision.

4. Build durable mechanisms, not one-off heroics

Create reusable playbooks, templates, dashboards, briefing formats, evidence standards, and operating cadences that scale beyond one person or one account.
Establish definitions and measurement for play health, product readiness, trust readiness, competitive momentum, and field adoption.
Continuously improve the operating model based on what is and is not helping teams win.
Coach partners on how to use the mechanisms without becoming the permanent coordination bottleneck.

What we are looking for
Required

Significant experience in product management, product operations, technical program management, enterprise strategy, solutions architecture, management consulting, or a closely related role in B2B enterprise software.
Experience working with complex enterprise customers and senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, Security, Legal, or Customer Success.
Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous customer, market, or competitive problems into a structured strategy and an executable operating plan.
Strong understanding of enterprise software buying, adoption, implementation, migration, expansion, and renewal dynamics.
Experience with one or more of: competitive displacement, enterprise transformation, platform strategy, trust and compliance, security products, regulated industries, or complex enterprise procurement.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can move from an executive narrative to evidence, requirements, trade-offs, and next actions without losing the thread.
Strong analytical judgment: you know how to distinguish fact, inference, hypothesis, and anecdote, and you do not overstate weak evidence.
Proven ability to influence outcomes through others without relying on formal authority.
Willingness to travel periodically for customer, field, and team engagements.

Preferred

Experience in service management, IT operations, developer tooling, enterprise workflow, platform, security, compliance, or adjacent B2B SaaS categories.
Direct experience competing with or migrating from large incumbent platforms.
Familiarity with security and compliance concepts such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, data residency, auditability, access control, and responsible AI governance.
Experience building field-to-product mechanisms, product-led sales plays, executive customer briefings, or competitive intelligence programs.
Experience with enterprise value engineering, business cases, pricing and packaging, or commercial strategy.
Experience operating across US, India, Australia, and other distributed teams.

The attributes that matter

Strategic but operational: You can define the direction and still close the loop on the hard details.
Evidence-led: You seek signal, label uncertainty, and change your mind when the evidence changes.
Commercially literate: You understand how product gaps, trust friction, packaging, implementation, and competitive positioning affect revenue.
Technically credible: You can earn the trust of engineers and security experts without pretending to be the deepest specialist in the room.
Customer-grounded: You care about the customer's operating problem, not just the feature request.
Low ego, high ownership: You give credit, surface risk early, and do what the outcome requires.
Clear under pressure: You make complex topics simpler without making them simplistic.
System builder: You leave behind mechanisms that make the organisation stronger.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

Role

In The United States
, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A
: $228,600 - $298,450

Zone B
: $205,740 - $268,605

Zone C
: $189,738 - $247,714

Qualifications

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits
.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh
.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Service Collection is building the next generation of enterprise service management: a governed, connected operating system that helps organisations transform how their people, technology, and services work together.

We are hiring a US-based Outbound Product Manager

Enterprise Trust & Compliance: translating security, compliance, data governance, residency, reliability, and regulated-industry requirements into product strategy, roadmap influence, field readiness, and customer proof.

The OPM is not a quota-carrying seller, and this is not a conventional product marketing role. You will sit at the intersection of product strategy and the field as a mini GM: identifying patterns in enterprise opportunities, converting customer and competitive evidence into product action, shaping the narrative and proof points for strategic plays, and building the operating mechanisms that allow teams to execute consistently.
